title: Healthy shift
talk_track: Loaders cycle at the drawpoints and trucks cycle on the drifts. Passes and buffers sit in their target band and the main hoist matches plan. The mine is in automatic operation.

title: Truck stuck in a drift
talk_track: KIR-TRK-014 is stuck in drift KIR-DRF-1220-N with path blocked and speed zero. KIR-TRK-021 waits behind it. Loaders keep filling the passes so crushing and hoisting stay healthy.

title: Loader stopped at a drawpoint
expected_bands: Draw and load Warning. Crushing and hoisting Healthy
talk_track: KIR-LHD-007 stops at KIR-DP-1220-04 on a hangup (skut). Pass A inflow falls by that loader's share. The pass and the buffers still feed the crusher: a stopped robot is local until the surge is gone.

title: Cascade to crusher and hoist
expected_bands: Draw and autonomy Critical. Crushing Warning. Hoisting Critical. Parent Critical. Outbound Warning
talk_track: A second loader on pass A stops on comms loss. Pass A runs low then crusher KIR-CRU-01 idles then the buffer pockets drain and the main hoist runs under plan. Plant feed is at risk. Rail is not cancelled.

title: Recovery
expected_bands: Production path back to Healthy within about three minutes
talk_track: The truck clears first then the loaders and comms then the pass and crusher then the buffers and the main hoist. Alarms close with an end time.
